text.tspan: • Protects against unintended deletes (DELETE adds a
delete marker; old versions stay) · easy rollback
• Objects from before versioning have version ID null
• Suspending keeps old versions; you can never go back
to "unversioned" · best practice: turn it on
• Versioning ON in source AND destination · IAM role for S3
• Buckets can be in different accounts
• CRR: compliance, lower latency, cross-account copies
• SRR: log aggregation, live prod → test replication
• Only NEW objects after you enable it; existing and
No chaining: objects made in bucket 1
• Delete markers: replicated only if you turn on the optional "delete marker replication" setting.
• DELETE with a version ID (permanent delete of a version): never replicated, to avoid malicious deletes.
• Types are CRR (different Regions) and SRR (same Region). "Batch" is not a third type: S3 Batch Replication is how you copy
objects that existed before the rule, objects that failed, or replicas (on demand, as a Batch Operations job).
• SRR has no data transfer charge; CRR pays inter-Region transfer.
